Vivek — thanks for the heads-up. Inventory snapshot attached (gpu_inventory_snapshot_20260403.csv). TL;DR: we have two eligible pools in us-east with spare capacity today; one pool can cover 8 A100-equivalents immediately for a 21-day window, the other has scheduled maintenance on 2026-04-10 that would interfere.

Notes:
- We recommend holding Pool-EAST-3 (no scheduled maint) for the 21 days. That will reserve NVLink-enabled nodes matching the A100 profile.
- Operational hold policy: standard provisional hold = 20% of list price per week (prorated) unless counter-offer approved by Revenue Ops.
- Implication for Dedicated customers on nearby pools: negligible given current utilization but call out if Helio expands beyond 8 GPUs.

Attachments: gpu_inventory_snapshot_20260403.csv

If you want me to place the provisional hold now, I can do it and generate the hold ticket + automated billing note; will need a signed MOA or purchase intent email to start the billing clock.

—Marissa

- Billing trigger: hold starts the provisional billing clock; rates are 20% list/week prorated unless Revenue Ops approves a different fee.
